summary: The foundation code follows the approved module boundaries: configuration is centralized, SQLite owns only technical state, scheduler constants are separate from runtime settings, storage paths are owned by app.storage.paths, and external integrations are represented by protocols/fakes without live SDKs. No blocking code quality findings were identified.

checks.name: Module boundaries
checks.evidence: Bot, sheets, services, storage, scheduler, reports, and speech modules are separated and import only local boundary types or standard library dependencies.

checks.name: Single ownership of shared resources
checks.evidence: StoragePathPolicy is reused by report boundaries; scheduler constants are owned by app.scheduler.calendar; SQLite schema is owned by app.storage.sqlite.

checks.name: No scope creep into user flows
checks.evidence: No Telegram handlers, Google API calls, PDF generation implementation, or transcription provider implementation were introduced.

residualRisks.description: Boundary fakes are intentionally thin; future live integration tasks must add adapter-specific validation and error handling.
